description: Lists incidents. Without `server_id` — across the whole account, sorted by start time desc; with `server_id` — only that monitor. `status` and `project_id` filters apply only to the account-wide form. Time depth is limited by the `incident_retention_days` plan feature.

project_id.description: Only incidents of monitors in this project. Omitted, the whole account is returned.

server_id.description: Limit to one monitor. If set, `status` and `project_id` filters are ignored.

name: incident_list
title: List incidents
